learning: Executed negative/decomposition finding: (1) On a1 the SWA host-sync + fast-plan exact-runtime family is throughput-neutral in the frozen BF16 Fast screen (i4 x1.0017 with the entire family in-tree) -- a1's earlier cross-hunk attribution (+0.5% over fp8) was within noise; a2's x1.05 did not transfer.
